packages/contracts/src/settings.ts.why: Fork settings live in forkSettings.ts; settings.ts takes them with one spread per struct. automaticUpdates stays inline: upstream's pending setting has the same name and place.

* one when it lands (upstream defaults it on). A file saying `autoUpdateServer` is renamed on load.

packages/shared/src/serverSettings.ts.why: A settings patch's fork fields are applied by forkSettingsPatch.ts, by the rules in forkSettings.ts.

apps/server/src/serverSettings.ts.why: Every settings write goes through upstream's patch and write paths here. The fork swaps in its patch (fork/serverSettingsPatch.ts, under upstream's name, so a project's MCP profile a client left out is kept) and calls its save check (fork/serverSettingsWriteCheck.ts) once in each write path. The load decodes the file after fork/settingsFileRead.ts (old auto-update names renamed, an unusable interval left out so it reads as its default).
